system.description:
RHEVANI

The barrier between your incarnations has become thin enough that several lives may advise you at once.
Whenever you activate Past-Life Echo, you may select two skills rather than one. Both receive its normal benefits for the duration.
If you possess Lost Scholarship, one of these skills may instead be an eligible Lore specialist skill.

Prerequisites Level 15, Deep Recall

Works automatically: Past-Life Echo's Use asks for a second skill (or, with Lost Scholarship, a Lore).
